gloss.intro: Ko e ngaahi lea ʻoku ngāueʻaki ʻe he kau tohi polokalama (mo e ngaahi kautaha AI), ʻi he lea faingofua.
gloss.switch.help: Ko e ngaahi lea kuo tuhu ʻoku ma'u ai ha fakamatala faingofua ʻi he taimi ʻoku ke hanga ki ai.
gloss.backlog.text: Ngaahi fakakaukau mo e ngāue te'eki palani. ʻIkai ha me'a ʻe fai ai kae ʻoua ke ʻave ki he Ke fai.
gloss.sprint.text: Ko ha vaha'a ngāue nounou (ʻuhinga ko ha uike pe ua) mo ha ngaahi kaati kuo loto taha ke fakaʻosi.
gloss.standup.text: Ko ha sivi vave: ko e hā naʻe fai ʻe he mēmipa taki taha, ko e hā ʻe fai hoko, pea ko e hā ʻoku taʻofi ai.
gloss.bug.text: Ko ha me'a ʻoku ʻikai ngāue ʻo hangē ko e meʻa ʻoku totonu ke ngāue ai.
gloss.test.text: Feinga ki ha konga ngāue kuo ʻosi ke sivi pe ʻoku fai ʻa e me'a naʻe kole, kimuʻa pea tali.
gloss.commit.text: Ko ha tā kuo tauhi ʻo e koloa, mo ha fakamatala nounou ʻo e me'a naʻe liliu. Te ke lava maʻu pē ʻo foki ki ha taha.
gloss.push.text: Fekau e ngaahi tā kuo tauhi (commits) mei he komipiuta ni ki he GitHub, ke tauhi mo vahevahe.
gloss.branch.text: Ko ha laine ngāue kehe ʻi he koloa, ke lava ʻo fai ha ngaahi liliu taʻe ala ki he tuʻunga ʻaupito.
gloss.merge.text: Fakahoko e ngaahi liliu ʻo ha branch ki he tuʻunga ʻaupito.
gloss.repo.text: Ko e folda ʻo e poloseki ʻo e koloa mo hono hisitōlia kakato ʻo e ngaahi commit, ʻoku fa'a tauhi foki ʻi he GitHub.
gloss.refactor.text: Fakama'a e koloa taʻe liliu e me'a ʻoku ne fai: ngaahi fail siʻi ange, ngaahi hingoa mahino ange, toe lahi ange.
gloss.deploy.text: Fokotuʻu ha tuʻunga foʻou ke moʻui, hangē ko ha sēvā ʻoku ngāueʻaki ai ʻe he kakai.
gloss.kanban.text: Ko ha laupapa mo e ngaahi kolomu (Ke fai, ʻOku fakahoko, Kuo fai) ʻoku ʻalu ai e ngaahi kaati mei he mataʻu ki he maʻu ʻi he taimi ʻoku fai ai e ngāue.
gloss.wip.text: Ngāue ʻoku fakahoko: ko e lahi taha ʻo e ngaahi kaati ʻe lava ke hao ʻi ha kolomu, ke fakaʻosi ʻe he kautaha e ngaahi me'a kimuʻa pea kamata ha toe.
gloss.pr.text: Kole ke sivi mo fakatahaʻi ʻa e ngaahi liliu ʻo ha branch ki he tuʻunga ʻaupito.
gloss.hook.text: Ko ha fekau siʻisiʻi ʻoku lele ʻiate ia ʻi ha taimi kuo fokotuʻu, hangē ko e ʻi he kamata ʻa ha sēsini AI, ke fanongo ʻa e kautaha ki hoʻo ngaahi fakamatala.
gloss.token.text: Ko e iuniti ʻoku lau ai e ngāueʻaki AI: ʻuhinga ko ha mataʻitohi siʻi ʻo e tohi kuo lau pe tohi. Token siʻi ange, palani lahi ange ʻoku toe.
gloss.agent.text: Ko ha AI ʻoku ngāue ʻiate ia ki ha ngāue: lau e koloa, fai ha liliu, lele ha ngaahi sivi, pea lipooti mai.

tour.rail.text: ʻApi, hoʻo puha fakamatala, talanoa mo e kau taki, pea ko e ʻaikoni ʻe taha ki he poloseki taki taha. Ko e taimana viole ʻoku ʻuhinga ia ʻoku ʻi ai ha me'a ʻoku tatali kiate koe. Toho e ngaahi ʻaikoni ke tuku ʻi hoʻo fakamālie.
tour.rail.short: Ngaahi poloseki ʻi he laine (ʻi lalo ʻi ha telefoni); ko e ngaahi taimana lanu viole ʻoku ʻuhinga ʻoku ʻi ai ha meʻa ʻoku tatali kiate koe.

tour.inbox.title: Hoʻo puha fakamatala
tour.inbox.text: Ko e me'a kotoa ʻoku tatali kiate koe, ʻi he ngaahi poloseki kotoa: ngaahi fehuʻi, ngaahi ngāue ʻe lava pē ʻe koe ʻo fai, mo e ngaahi me'a ke sivi. Lomi ha chip ke sio ki he lahi pē ko ia.
tour.inbox.short: Ko e me'a kotoa ʻoku tatali kiate koe, ʻi he feituʻu kotoa. Lomi ha chip ki he lahi ʻe taha.
tour.inbox.why: ʻOku ʻikai totonu ke ke ō ki he poloseki kotoa ke ʻilo e me'a ʻoku fiemaʻu koe.
tour.foryou.title: Maʻau
tour.foryou.text: ʻI ha laupapa, ko e kolomu ni ʻoku ne ʻi ai e me'a ʻoku tatali kiate koe ʻi he poloseki ko ia. Fakaava ha sivi, muimui ki hono ngaahi laine, pea Tali pe Fakafoki mo ha taumuʻa.
tour.foryou.short: Ko e fulifuli ʻo e poloseki ni maʻau: sivi, pea Tali pe Fakafoki.
tour.foryou.why: ʻOku ʻikai ke fakaʻosi ʻe he ngaahi kautaha ʻenau ngāue ʻaʻana: ko koe ʻoku tali. ʻOku ne tauhi e tuʻunga lelei ʻi hoʻo nima.
tour.cards.title: Ngaahi kolomu ʻa e kautaha
tour.cards.text: Ko e toenga ʻo e laupapa ko e ngāue ʻa e ngaahi kautaha: Backlog, Ke fai, ʻOku fakahoko, pea toe. Fai ha fakamatala ʻi ha kaati pea ʻoku ueʻi e kautaha ke fai ki ai.
tour.cards.short: Ko e ngāue ʻa e ngaahi kautaha. Fai ha fakamatala ʻi ha kaati ke ueʻi kinautolu.
tour.cards.why: Ko hoʻo ngaahi fakamatala ko e ngaahi fekau. ʻOku kamataʻi ʻe he laupapa e kautaha ʻi he taimi ʻoku ke tohi ai.
tour.chat.title: Talanoa mo e kau taki
tour.chat.text: Fekau ha fakamatala ki he taki ʻo ha poloseki mo ha fakakaukau pe fehuʻi. ʻOku nau liliu e ngaahi fakakaukau ki he ngaahi kaati mo ha palani nounou, mo e ngaahi fakamau Fai maʻau.
tour.chat.short: Fekau ha fakamatala ki ha taki; te nau palani pea ke lomi Fai.
tour.chat.why: ʻIkai ha me'a ʻe langa kae ʻoua ke ke pehē Fai: ko koe ʻoku pule ki he me'a ʻoku hoko.
tour.setup.title: Fokotuʻu
tour.setup.text: Ho hingoa, lea, fōtunga mo e feituʻu ʻoku nofo ai e AI ʻi he komipiuta ni. ʻOku ʻi ai foki ha suiti ke fakamatala e ngaahi lea polokalama, mo e fakahinohino lea.
